description: Operational knobs selected by the GPU a stage runs on (natlang_neuralese/train/hardware_profile.py). Profiles may select native activation checkpointing and execution environment switches; training math and objectives stay in the shared recipes. Matched in order; NATLANG_HARDWARE_PROFILE=<name>|none overrides. A profile with empty stage_parameters runs the recipe unchanged.

profiles.name: dgx-gb10
profiles.status: baseline: the native recipe already uses the measured DGX execution settings; nothing to override

profiles.name: rtx-pro-6000-blackwell
profiles.status: allocator setting only; native stage parameters remain recipe-owned

train-mellum.reason: the 47 GB checkpoint.pt is loaded with map_location=cpu (plus the 23 GB model safetensors read once) and saved from host copies; 160Gi covers load plus a save in flight. Dataloading is in-process tokenized JSONL: 16 cores leave headroom for the inductor/Triton compile workers and the bundle publisher. Re-size from the bench's host peak (hw-bench.json host_peak_gb)

train-lfm.reason: 350M parameters: checkpoints are a few GB; the union text data is read once

eval.reason: task-success eval: node workers plus model load (scripts/coreweave/jobs/heldv2-base-mellum.json)

teacher.reason: vLLM: weights are staged through host memory at load; tokenization and the API server use a few cores; prefix-cache CPU offload is off

profiles.name: pop-ada
profiles.status: baseline for the native LFM line on Pop; Pop owns any override
